correctness.rationale: The arbitrary-projection minimum is obtained by averaging over sign-cube translations and the absolute version uses the published Walsh projection theorem. The vertex-edge map for a connected unicyclic graph is exactly two-to-one onto one product constraint. The flip-Laplacian formulas for |S_m| and hypergeometric binomial coefficient extract exactly the conditional correction for all m and ell. Strict sign, endpoints and Stirling asymptotics follow with no missing quantifiers. The actual standalone verify.py passed all 45 exhaustive small cases, but finite checks are not used as proof.

value.rationale: This evaluates a natural sharp complementability invariant for all connected unicyclic graph-supported quadratic Walsh spaces, revealing a genuine mod-four trichotomy and the quantitative weakening of a single cycle constraint under attached tree extensions. It gives exact contractive C4 and expansive C6 witnesses compared with fixed-edge-count forests; general kernel formulas alone do not state these structural boundary phenomena.
